Verano believes in decriminalizing and democratizing cannabis for all, including granting cannabis clemency to nonviolent offenders. Until the world catches up with us, find out if you live in a cannabis legal state.
Explore the Verano and Mission Green commitment to cannabis clemency and other decriminalization efforts.
Cannabis Education for Every Desire, Taste, and Comfort Level
All are welcome here. Whether you’re a newcomer or a cannabis connoisseur, we’re honored to share our expertise with you.
At our cannabis dispensaries, we’re lavish with our top-tier focus on hospitality, our premium ingredients, and those who put their trust in us.

Cannabis is gaining acceptance nationwide, and our legal system should reflect the progress. The Weldon Project’s Mission Green is a leader in clemency, expungement, and pardons for persons currently or formerly incarcerated due to nonviolent cannabis-related charges. The nonprofit has a personal connection to the issue; it was founded by Weldon Angelos after serving 13 years of a 55-year sentence.
Because our legal system should reflect cannabis’ growing acceptance.

Verano is honored to continue its annual Pride Month partnerships with COH through volunteer events and donations. This past June the Verano Team had the pleasure of serving local seniors at COH’s Senior Town Hall dinner along with making a $5,000 donation to support their mission of securing the health and well-being of the LGBTQ people of Chicagoland. Verano participates in the senior dinner every June.
Because community is everything, we’re proud to support these outstanding social organizations.
Our Work Lights Us Up
We’re electrified by cannabis curiosity. You too? Check out Verano careers.

pages.raw_meta: Learn how Verano goes above and beyond to cultivate premium products that prove cannabis can and should be better.
raw_blocks: In an uncertain world with decades of fear-led messaging telling us no, we are dedicated to the elevated exploration of yes.
Cannabis can and should be better

Yes, all are welcome here. Yes, relief is available. Yes, there is a strain for you, and yes, we can make this industry work for all of us. Our premium products prove that cannabis can be better. And by further democratizing and decriminalizing our industry, we’re proving that cannabis can do better, too.
Humbled by the power of this plant, we handcraft consistently elevated cannabis goods for every desire, taste, and comfort level.

In 14 state-of-the-art cultivation and production facilities—sustainably designed to suit the unique seasonality and climate of every region we serve—our expert growers thoughtfully tend to our nationwide library of signature strains. This way, we ensure each Verano plant is organic, local, and exceptionally effective—every time.
Cultivate our premium flower in-house

Many cannabis companies outsource their flower, but Verano is different. We entrust our cannabis experts, alone, to cultivate each of our exceptional strains. Then, in small batches, we craft our plants into premium products for cannabis newcomers and connoisseurs alike.
Go above and beyond quality standards

With precision and pride, we verify the dosage and cannabinoid quality of every Verano product, from sleep gummies to body balm. Our growers, scientists, and culinary team exceed strict safety regulations at every stage of production—and that care extends to our dispensaries, where we expertly guide cannabis experiences to soothe, delight, and heal.
Growing Plants, Communities, and Careers
14 Cultivation & production facilities spanning 1,000,000+ sq. ft.
At our cannabis dispensaries, we’re lavish with our top-tier focus on hospitality, our premium ingredients, and those who put their trust in us.
Giving back where we can

Located in Chicago’s Lakeview neighborhood, Center on Halsted is the Midwest’s most comprehensive LGBTQ community center. The Verano Team was honored to serve local seniors at Center on Halsted’s monthly Senior Townhall dinner, and it was our pleasure to participate in Youth Program Community Day.
Our work lights us up
We’re electrified by cannabis curiosity. You too? Check out Verano careers.
